Nora: FYI - CrestView dropped into amber (health 43%). Notable dip in embeddings pipeline usage this month, looks like they stalled after first-week POC. Thinking a short 10-day re-activate play focused on product unblock + value callbacks. Thoughts?
Samir: Agreed. Quick ask: can we verify SDK keys haven't rotated? I saw a 401 spike in logs.
CS Bot: [alert] CrestView: auth.errors spike +401 = 27 in last 48h. last_seen_event 2025-05-01T14:08Z. avg_p50_latency ok.
Leah: If auth is the cause we do a quick dev huddle. But if it's behavioral, a 10-day "value sprint" with 2 office hours + tailored prompts should help.
Diego: I can surface a small sample dataset and a pre-built query pack to reduce friction. ETA 24h.
Nora: My proposed play: Day 0 kickoff email + checklist. Day 1 SDK/key health check (Samir). Day 2 in-app micro-tour for embed pipeline (Ivy). Day 4 office hour (Leah + Diego). Day 7 proactive query examples + short A/B of prompt templates. Day 9 check-in + retro; if engagement >= threshold, apply $300 contingent credit.
Samir: On credit, ops: prefer conditional apply. I'll add a billing tag but only apply after events: `embed.indexed` >= 1000 && `user.sessions` >= 5 in 7d.
Ivy: I'll adapt the micro-tour we used for QuantaLabs, reduce copy to one slide per step. Can ship in 36h.
Marcus: From renewals lens, hold off on lowering price. Contingent credit ok. If we don't see lift by day 8 escalate to SE-led workshop.
Leah: Email draft (short):
```
Subject: Quick 10-day re-activate for CrestView
Hi Team,
We noticed your team slowed after the POC. Want to run a focused 10-day value sprint: 1) quick SDK check, 2) in-app micro-tour, 3) two office hours, 4) sample queries. If adoption milestones hit, we'll credit $300 back to your account.
Are mornings this week good for a 15-min kickoff?
Thanks, Nora
```
Diego: Checklist idea: 1) SDK success ping, 2) sample dataset indexed, 3) first 50 semantic queries, 4) positive retrieval examples saved. I'll post the query pack link in 3 hours.
Nora: Assignments: Samir auth triage, Ivy micro-tour, Diego query pack + sample dataset, Leah office hours owner, Marcus renewal follow. I'll open the CS playbook task and tag owners.
Samir: I'll add a monitoring rule to flag 401 regressions and post the runbook snippet: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings`
Leah: I'll schedule 2 office hours on Wed/Thu 10am PT and add calendar invites.
Ivy: Micro-tour done and pushed to staging. Hooked `embed.indexed` events to analytics.
CS Bot: [metric] CrestView engagement: embed.indexed=0 -> 420 in 72h after micro-tour deploy.
Nora: Nice — early signal. If we hit Diego's checklist thresholds by day 7 we trigger the credit. Documenting contingency here so renewals team can see.
Marcus: Noted. If no lift by day 8 escalate to SE workshop + open QBR slot.
Nora: I'll ping CrestView now and paste any reply here. Keep this thread for play progress updates. :white_check_mark:
